title: Post-Construction Cleaning
description: TNT Domestics provides post-construction cleaning in San Antonio, Texas, including rough clean, final clean, and punch-list touch-ups.
intro: TNT Domestics provides post-construction cleaning in San Antonio, Texas, including rough clean, final clean, and punch-list touch-ups.

sections.title: What the service includes
sections.text: Rough cleaning removes accessible construction debris and prepares spaces for the next stage of work. Final cleaning focuses on dust, interior surfaces, cabinetry, fixtures, floors and glass within the agreed scope. Punch-list touch-ups address areas affected by the last trades before a walkthrough or handover.

sections.title: Who this service is for
sections.text: Post-Construction Cleaning is intended for general contractors, builders, developers and property managers. Each property or facility has different expectations, so we begin by asking about the purpose of the cleaning, the current condition of the space and the outcome you need. Photos, floor plans or an existing checklist can help clarify a project, but we confirm the scope directly rather than assume that every task is included.

sections.title: Our process
sections.text: We coordinate with the contractor to understand the construction schedule, site access, utilities and remaining trade activity. Cleaning is planned around the condition of the site rather than a one-size-fits-all checklist. We gather the project details, review the requested work, clarify questions and provide a tailored quote. Once the scope and timing are agreed, we coordinate access and carry out the cleaning against those agreed priorities. If site conditions or the requested work change, we discuss those changes rather than promise an undefined service.

sections.title: Where we serve
sections.text: TNT Domestics serves Texas, California and Hawaii and is based in San Antonio. Texas enquiries include Alamo Heights, Olmos Park, Terrell Hills and Boerne, along with high-end service requests in Austin, Dallas and Houston. Tell us the exact property location so we can confirm scheduling and project fit. In California, we serve the San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles and Orange County, San Diego and Sacramento; contact us with your exact project location.

sections.title: Request a tailored quote
sections.text: Provide your name, phone number, email, service needed, property location and project details through our on-site quote form. Include the approximate size of the space, desired timing and any access or material requirements. We respond to enquiries within 24 business hours. A request is not a confirmed booking; the scope, price and schedule are agreed with you before work begins.

faqs: Does cleaning include every construction surface?
The quote identifies the surfaces and phases included. Specialty finishes, high-access glass, adhesive removal and disposal requirements should be discussed before work begins.
How is pricing determined?
Pricing depends on the size, condition, scope, location and timing of your project. Request a tailored quote; we do not publish a single price for every property.
